title: docs(spec, docs): App.defaultAgent's docblock and actions-as-tools.mdx name POST /api/v1/ai/assistant/chat, a route cloud retired (cloud#2621)
body:
Filing gate: ③ release text that a landed change makes false. Filed by the `repo:cloud` seat (`repo:cloud#1`, session `session_01Wxo1xhh2bU66T73q23jzE4`, R44), from the objectstack-ai/cloud#2621 os-dev report 6011436878 (`out_of_scope_findings` 2). Reader: the triage seat, for grading.

## The change

The maintainer ruled A on objectstack-ai/cloud#2621 (triage ruling 6010663551) to retire `GET /api/v1/ai/assistant`, `GET /api/v1/ai/assistant/skills` and `POST /api/v1/ai/assistant/chat`. PR objectstack-ai/cloud#2651 removes them, and the agent route is the one chat door. After it, the assistant chat endpoint answers 404, and no server route reads `App.defaultAgent`.

## Text that is now false (framework `8832655a`, unchanged on `main` `80f9f7e6`)

- `packages/spec/src/ui/app.zod.ts:1655-1666`, the `App.defaultAgent` docblock, says: "When set, the assistant chat endpoint (`POST /api/v1/ai/assistant/chat`) resolves this agent for a call carrying `context.appName` … that route is what drives the resolution chain". It ships in `dist/ui/index.mjs`.
- `content/docs/ai/actions-as-tools.mdx:275` lists `/api/v1/ai/assistant/chat` as an in-product chat route.

## Readers that remain

objectui still reads `defaultAgent` in `packages/app-shell/src/hooks/surfaceAgent.ts` and `layout/ChatDock.tsx`, limited to the ask and build agents. So the field is not dead. What is false is that docblock's account of the server route.

## Ask

Correct both texts to the current server: the agent route, and `defaultAgent` as read by the console. Whether `defaultAgent` needs a server consumer at all is a separate question for its owner.

Dedupe: this was read on both sites. No open card names either text.
